overrides.about.privacy: Your journal and account data stay on this phone. Andarz has no ads and sends nothing from the journal. Only the Market section connects to the internet to read prices, and only when you turn it on.
overrides.onb.privacy.body: Andarz's journal and rules work offline and no data leaves them. Only the Market section, if you turn it on, connects to the internet to read prices. You create and keep the encrypted backup yourself; if you lose its password, no one can recover it.
